page_title: BRE 4-0 ETI | Brest v St Etienne 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Axel Camblan (Brest) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
90+4' He should have scored! Mahdi Camara (Brest) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
90+2' Referee Gael Angoula sees the trip by Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
89' Corner kicks – 7:2.
86' Substitution. Axel Camblan (Brest) on for Romain Del Castillo.
85' Here is a change. Mathis Amougou is going off and Olivier Dall'Oglio gives the last tactical orders to Florian Tardieu (St Etienne).
85' Here comes a substitution. Pierre Cornud is given a rest as he is replaced by Leo Petrot (St Etienne).
84' 4 - 0 Goal! Kenny Lala (Brest) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Gautier Larsonneur to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
84' Kenny Lala (Brest) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
82' The referee gives a yellow card to Pierre Cornud (St Etienne).
82' Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) makes a strong challenge and Gael Angoula blows for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Brest!
82' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes it short.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.
78' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his low effort is straight at Gautier Larsonneur.
77' 3 - 0 Goal! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
75' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) replacing Romain Faivre.
74' Julien Le Cardinal comes off the pitch to be replaced by Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Amavi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Luc Zogbe (Brest).
73' Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Bizot punches the ball away.
72' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' The resulting corner from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) comes to nothing.
70' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. St Etienne will take a corner kick.
70' What a huge chance for Jonas Martin (Brest). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
68' Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Gael Angoula saw the whole situation.
67' The game has come to an end for Abdallah Sima. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jonas Martin (Brest).
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
63' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) is able to continue to play.
62' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St Etienne, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
59' Substitution. Lamine Fomba is replaced by Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne).
59' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Ayman Aiki and he is replaced by Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne).
59' Substitution. Yvann Macon makes way for Dennis Appiah (St Etienne).
57' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
56' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
54' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
52' Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
50' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

48' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
48' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+5' The ball is cleared after Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Brest as they win a corner.
45+3' Poor challenge! Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) is penalised for tripping and Gael Angoula blows his whistle.
45+2' A cross into the box finds the head of Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) who steers it goalwards, but Gautier Larsonneur manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
45+1' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Brest players are visibly unhappy with the call.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Referee Gael Angoula makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Brest. Let’s see what happens!
44' That looked a certain handball by Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
43' Gael Angoula has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jordan Amavi (Brest).
41' Romain Faivre (Brest) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Brest have a corner.

40' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gael Angoula with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brest.
38' Abdallah Sima (Brest) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.

37' Ambitious effort from Ayman Aiki (St Etienne). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
37' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
32' 2 - 0 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Gautier Larsonneur to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
31' Handball! A player from St Etienne handled the ball. It's a penalty for Brest!
30' This is a yellow card! Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
26' None of the Brest players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
26' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Brest force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Kenny Lala (Brest) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Abdallah Sima (Brest) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
19' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brest.
16' A precise low pass is received by Mahdi Camara (Brest), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
15' The free kick is taken by Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne), but ball is cleared.
10' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mahdi Camara (Brest) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 1:0.
10' Corner kick. Brest will have an opportunity.
10' Abdallah Sima (Brest) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. Now Brest have a corner.
10' Gael Angoula interrupts the game. One of the players from St Etienne won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
8' Abdallah Sima (Brest) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Gautier Larsonneur.
5' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) was too forceful with his tackle and Gael Angoula interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' A wild pass somehow finds Romain Faivre (Brest) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.

2' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
1' The match has just started.
Gael Angoula was nominated as the referee for this game.
